description.p: AIVPlayer combines local video playback, subtitle workflows, image tools, and media search in one desktop application.

It can generate subtitles with a local ASR engine, edit clips without changing the source media, and keep visual evidence in a local library. Optional translation and summary features use the service configured by the user.

screenshot.caption: Arrange clips, subtitles and visual evidence on the editing timeline
